writeup: TIC 295254637 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 5.33 days, observed to dim by 3.87% at primary eclipse with no detected secondary eclipse. The eclipse signal achieved a detection significance of 176.9 in automated photometric analysis, and pixel-level imaging confirmed the signal at the target location with a peak signal-to-noise ratio of 25.9. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs. However, analysis reveals that successive eclipses vary significantly in depth, suggesting the initially measured period was half the true orbital period; the corrected period is 5.329910 days. While the pixel confirmation and eclipse timing remain unaffected by this period revision, the alternating eclipse-depth pattern represents an open question about the system's nature and requires attention in any further investigation.
